title: ZeroFlat – Rust + Rinf + FlatBuffers + Forui SDUI
tagline: Zero logic frontend. Zero hand-written FlatBuffers. Zero unnecessary abstraction.
goal: Rust owns logic, rules, state, and AI design. Flutter is a thin, delightful renderer using Forui. ID-based deltas for Patrol. Instant theming. AI turns natural language + coordinates into production forms.
philosophy: Rust = Brain (speed, safety, Conduit rules, AI orchestration)
Flutter = Canvas (Forui polish, gestures, themes, Lens overlay)

sections.1_form_handling: 1. Rust sends full UIMessage with root + current values. 2. Flutter uses local controllers / Forui hooks (native typing). 3. On blur or debounce each component sends its own update to Rust. 4. Rust updates canonical state → runs Conduit rules → sends only affected deltas. 5. Flutter applies deltas by ID.
sections.2_rinf_signals: Dart: SendFieldUpdate, SendAction, SendDesignCommand. Rust: SendUiUpdate for FlatBuffer payloads.
sections.3_flatbuffers: UIComponent with required id, type, props, children; Delta with target_id; UIMessage.
sections.4_renderer: Use HookWidget for form fields. Thin mapping layer (buildForuiComponent) that turns semantic types into Forui widgets with ValueKey(id) for Patrol.
sections.5_themes: AppThemeProvider with ValueNotifier<FThemeData> + FTheme wrapper. Switch themes instantly. CLI-generated themes.
sections.6_ai_design: Pure-text first. Folder: design_ideas/idea_01.txt with natural language + optional coordinates. Watcher → LLM → FlatBuffer/deltas → render. Lens overlay: grid + hover IDs + command bar.
sections.7_testing: Reuse Forui widget tests. ID-based Patrol finders. Layers: low-level (Forui), component mappings, integration (Patrol), AI validation (schema + rules). Lens for exploratory testing.
sections.8_effort: Week 1: core renderer + forms. Week 2: themes + Conduit. Week 3: AI watcher + Lens.

benefits: AI-generative UI with iterative Lens feedback
conclusion: Forward-looking break from traditional heavy UI baggage while keeping what adds value.
